IIST CAMPUS · VERSION 2

Built from the map.

24 mapped building footprints, campus roads, footpaths and sports areas. Positions and shapes come from your OpenStreetMap export.

Red-brown walls, pale framing, the Library facade, tropical trees and the Student Activity Centre amphitheatre are informed by your reference photos. Terrain rises toward the hostels; buildings sit on terraces and roads follow the ground. One pond uses its OSM outline; the west pond is estimated from the supplied screenshots. Heights, slopes and architectural details remain approximations, not a surveyed reconstruction. No interiors are included.

Use WASD or arrow keys to walk, Shift to sprint, and the mouse to look. Click the scene to capture the mouse, or drag to look when capture is unavailable. Press V for an aerial view. On touch screens, use the arrow pad and drag the scene.

The minimap shows your position. Use “Go to a place” to travel quickly. Campus layout coverage is limited to the supplied map.
